senses.sense_definition: Мужская или женская одежда без рукавов, надеваемая поверх рубашки или блузки.

examples.text: На деловую встречу он надел строгий костюм и классический <w>жилет</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: For the business meeting, he wore a formal suit and a classic <w>waistcoat</w>.

examples.text: В прохладную погоду удобно носить тёплый вязаный <w>жилет</w> поверх свитера.

target_lang_translations.en: In cool weather, it is comfortable to wear a warm knitted <w>vest</w> over a sweater.

target_lang_definitions.en: A sleeveless garment worn over a shirt or blouse, often as part of a suit or for warmth.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: A sleeveless garment worn over a shirt, often as part of a suit (US/Canada).
A formal sleeveless garment worn over a shirt, typically as part of a three-piece suit (UK).
A sleeveless jacket, often quilted or warm, worn as an outer layer.
